sections.label: Login
sections.purpose: Single Login sidebar entry for extension-owned authentication setup, settings, policy, and credential references. Replaces the prior per-feature config pages so the dashboard sidebar surfaces broad work areas, not every sub-feature.

dashboardCards.description: Shows login-backed account growth, verification, active login, invite, and provider-mix health.
dashboardCards.purpose: Compact identity health card for repeated admin dashboard review.

hostServices.purpose: Vault Team and Cedros Data Team can list redacted login metadata, send org-scoped team invites, and delegate password reset actions when cedros-login is active.
hostServices.temporaryPasswordBehavior: fail-closed; Cedros Login does not issue temporary passwords

crmIntegrationDecision.summary: Cedros Login registers a single Extension Settings-group login/account settings section. Cedros Data owns the Users-group Team, Permissions, and Invite surfaces and reads our roster through the cedros-login-team-directory host service; it remains the CRM surface for people, prospects, customers, and lifecycle records.
identityIntegration: login-backed identity records are exposed through cedros-login server/database contracts
account status, auth provider, roles, and login metadata remain host-mediated CRM data
permission-gated account actions use cedros-login routes and CRM/Team integration points instead of duplicate Customers pages
account creation, login activity, and lifecycle event metadata remains declared in analytics/server events

hostIntegrationSurfaces.label: CRM (integration)
hostIntegrationSurfaces.purpose: Render login-backed identity records, account status, roles, provider metadata, and profile handoff actions inside CRM profiles.

hostIntegrationSurfaces.label: Users > Team
hostIntegrationSurfaces.purpose: Cedros Data owns the Team workspace and reads our roster via the cedros-login-team-directory host service; the extension no longer registers a Team admin section.

hostIntegrationSurfaces.label: Users > Invite Team Members
hostIntegrationSurfaces.purpose: Cedros Data owns the Invite Team Members action; the extension no longer registers an invite route.

hostIntegrationSurfaces.label: Extension Settings > Login
hostIntegrationSurfaces.purpose: Single consolidated Login admin page; replaces Cedros Data Settings > Account through explicit section aliases.

acceptanceChecks: Admin registration returns the executable Login section; Team and Invite Team Members are host-owned.
adminModules[0].sectionIcons resolves every declared section to a host icon name so the sidebar renders with an icon when the host loads from manifest only.
cedros-login-team-directory is exposed by the admin runtime bootstrap for Vault Team metadata and action delegation.
Cedros Data should not create a separate Customers sidebar/page from cedros-login metadata.
adminModules[0].contributions.dashboardCards declares cedros-login:identity-health-card and the runtime bootstrap provides the component.
The cedros-login:setup-login onboarding page targets the declared cedros-login:admin / cedros-login:login section.
